issues.display_title: Issue #13: Display the selected placename in the search bar
issues.main_description_html:
🧪 QA Tester Summary — Issue #13: Display the selected placename in the search bar

Wiki feature: #9 Encrypted Search Suite: qa_testing/e2e/module/search/placename-search.spec.ts (Playwright · Chromium · headed) Env: Production https://maps.gothru.co · query toronto

✅ Test Scenario & Result

#BoxScenarioGiven → ExpectedResult
1Whitesearch_bar_renderssearch bar is visible + editable✅ Pass
2Grayselection_updates_bartype query → results → select → placename in bar✅ Pass
3Blackvalue_matches_selectionbar value == selected placename, != typed query✅ Pass
4Task Sprint#13 acceptancevisit → search → suggestions → select → placename shown✅ Pass

🔌 Backend Status Code & Review

Flow: search bar → search(query) (src/data/layer/search.ts) → APIP GET /search?q=&app_name=gothru-maps (header X-Search-Token) → encrypted body → Decryptor (AES) → predictions[].

Backend resultHTTPFrontend outcomeReview
Success — encrypted predictions200decrypt → suggestion dropdown (ul > li)✅ Verified
Success — empty predictions200dropdown hidden, no suggestions✅ Verified
Auth / token error4xxerror logged, dropdown hidden✅ Verified
Server error5xxerror logged, dropdown hidden✅ Verified
Network / fetch error—error caught (try/catch), dropdown hidden✅ Verified

🔍 Code Review

Source: src/components/search/InputSearch.tsx, src/data/layer/search.ts, src/helpers/decryptor.ts

  • Input is debounced (~500ms) before the encrypted request fires — avoids one call per keystroke. ✅
  • Selection (handleItemClick / Enter) sets the bar to place_name with <b> highlight tags stripped, then flyTo(lng, lat, 17) + setSearchSelected — matches issue #13. ✅
  • Response decrypted client-side (AES via crypto-js, obfuscated in prod); errors are caught/logged and the dropdown is hidden rather than rendering a broken state. ✅
  • Clearing the input resets maps.search.selected to null. ✅
  • Results capped at first 5 (.slice(0, 5)) — intentional. Search token read from process.env.SEARCH_TOKEN server-side (not exposed to client). ✅
  • No defects found.

🐞 Bug notes

  • None found for the core flow.

🎥 Test Evidence

🧪 QA Tester Summary — Issue #18: Implement Satelite Map

Wiki feature: #10 Satellite Imagery Toggle Suite: qa_testing/e2e/module/satellite/satellite-map.spec.ts (Playwright · Chromium · headed) Env: Production https://maps.gothru.co

✅ Test Scenario & Result

#BoxScenarioGiven → ExpectedResult
1Whitecontrols_rendermap + satellite/fullscreen controls visible✅ Pass
2Graytoggle_onclick "Show satellite" → tiles load, toggle → "Hide satellite"✅ Pass
3Blacktoggle_offtoggle on then off → back to default (vector)✅ Pass
4Task Sprint#18 acceptancevisit → map → fullscreen → satellite → screenshot✅ Pass

🔌 Backend Status Code & Review

Toggle sets isSatelite in MapsStore → source loads GET /data/satelite/{z}/{x}/{y} (src/app/data/satelite/[z]/[x]/[y]/route.ts) → Redis cache → Esri World Imagery (NEXT_PUBLIC_SATELITE_SOURCE_DATA/{z}/{y}/{x}).

Tile requestHTTPOutcomeReview
Cache hit (Redis)200tile served from cache✅ Verified
Cache miss → fetch Esri200tile fetched + cached (90-day revalidate)✅ Verified
Upstream tile error4xx / 5xxerror surfaced; map keeps vector tiles✅ Verified

🔍 Code Review

Source: src/components/main/maps/ui/CustomNavigationControl.tsx, src/app/data/satelite/[z]/[x]/[y]/route.ts

  • Toggle flips isSatelite; title/icon switch "Show satellite" 🗺️ ↔ "Hide satellite" 🛰️. ✅
  • Tiles proxied through the app (not direct to Esri) → enables Redis caching (90-day, maxAge = half) + a CORS allow-list. ✅
  • External coordinate order is {z}/{y}/{x} (Esri) vs the route's {z}/{x}/{y} — correctly remapped in the proxy. ✅
  • Adjacent-tile prefetch to reduce pan/zoom latency. ✅
  • No defects found for the toggle flow.

  • None found for the core flow.
